title: Backend Lab — redesign direction
question: The dice assigned Letterpress Specimen. Keep it, take the pick or an alternate, or re-roll (safer / bolder).

options.label: Letterpress Specimen
options.lineage: letterpress type specimen sheets & hand-set print shops
options.thesis: The console as a type specimen sheet: every number set at its point size, every state stamped in ink.
options.viewport: Sidebar as specimen index with point-size annotations; metrics as specimen numerals at 64px; statuses as rotated ink stamps.
options.risk: Serif-led specimen tone can drift fussy if the stamps and rules multiply.

raised.raise: Chrome deleted so the type is the interface — metric numerals at true specimen scale, boxes reduced to hairlines.
Nothing disappears, it cancels — cancelled/void states stamp in place and stay visible.
State carried in mark form, not hue alone — ink weight and double-strike distinguish states for a11y.

options.label: Engineering Vellum
options.lineage: engineering drawings on cream bond — title blocks, revision tables, dimension lines
options.thesis: Every screen is a drawing sheet: title block, revision letter, dimension-lined data, schedule tables.
options.viewport: Title block under the h1 (sheet no., rev, drawn-by); metrics with dimension-line callouts naming their endpoints; orders as a schedule-of-components table.
options.risk: The most familiar destination — engineering-drawing skins are where demo dashboards often land.

options.label: Ticket Wallet
options.lineage: jet-age airline ticket wallets — carbon-copy coupons, stamped states
options.thesis: Orders are coupons in a wallet: every order keeps its stub, and cancellation is a stamp, never a removal.
options.viewport: Each order as a coupon strip — stub with order no. + stamp, body with member/items/total, dashed perforation between.
options.case: Holds product clarity on orders (coupon topology maps cleanly); loses audience identification — airline nostalgia fights the engineering-demo story and the pinned cream palette flattens its official colors.
options.risk: Coupon grammar thins on notification/catalog surfaces that are not journeys.

options.label: Emission Line Rail
options.lineage: midnight spectrogram on a viewing box
options.thesis: Charcoal continuum; state as line height, dash and doubling — never hue.
options.viewport: Ops data as hairline marks hanging off one calibrated rail.
options.case: Kept line: state-in-mark-form + the dark-mode discipline — matte warm charcoal ground with cream hairlines (no cool black).
options.risk: Cold 3am-lab tone against the pinned warm cream brief.

options.label: Catalog Sleeve
options.lineage: matte black record sleeves, fac numbers, coded color strips
options.thesis: Vast unprinted dark ground; names replaced by coded strips the legend decodes.
options.viewport: Catalog index as the whole surface; fac-number headings.
options.case: Kept line: dark mode design — matte warm-charcoal, hairline structure, coded status strips decoded on hover.
options.risk: Withholding labels reads hostile for an operate console.

options.label: Star Atlas
options.lineage: celestial charts — magnitude dot sizes, coordinate spheres
options.thesis: Hierarchy by dot diameter on a fixed magnitude ramp; type declines to shout.
options.viewport: Data plotted as scaled points over coordinate hairlines.
options.case: Kept line: magnitude-as-size for numeric hierarchy.
options.risk: Navy/cold ground conflicts the pinned cream; metaphor outruns the data.

options.label: Metro Tiles
options.lineage: flat tile panoramas — giant lowercase, cropped headlines
options.thesis: Chrome deleted so the type itself is the interface.
options.viewport: Panorama of flat tiles, headlines cropped at the edge.
options.case: Kept line: chrome-deletion discipline — donated to the assigned direction.
options.risk: Flat fields fight the tactile paper world; type-cropped edges strain tables.

options.label: Midnight Transit
options.lineage: enamel rail maps — disciplined 45/90 bends, interchange circles
options.thesis: The city as a legible promise of movement; states named as systematically as stations.
options.viewport: Navigation as lines with station ticks; interchanges at crossings.
options.case: Kept line: a systematic state vocabulary (open/arriving/delayed/suspended) mapped identically across every surface.
options.risk: Transit chrome on a working screen is costume.

canonCard.label: Clean Neutral Console
canonCard.lineage: Linear/Vercel-class neutral admin consoles, played straight
canonCard.thesis: The category standard executed at full craft: cool-gray ground, one accent, perfect spacing.
canonCard.viewport: Standard sidebar + metrics + table, no world material.
canonCard.risk: Interchangeable with ten thousand dashboards — the exact verdict the current UI received.
